display_long_description:
CAUSE CHAOS IN CLASS
Step into the role of a mischievous student and turn your classroom upside down! Your main task is simple: disrupt everything and everyone. Throw apples at classmates, prank teachers with funny tricks, and make the classroom a chaotic playground.

FLIP THE CLASSROOM

Knock over desks, throw students and teachers around, and watch the hilarious reactions. From slapping pranks to over-the-top mayhem, nothing is off-limits in your mission to create total disorder.
[media]


DRINK THE GIANT POTION

Grab the magical potion and watch yourself grow into a towering giant! Smash through desks, lift classmates and teachers.

[media]

PURE FUN AND LAUGHTER
I’m a Rascal! is all about hilarious moments, chaos, and over-the-top mischief. Are you ready to cause mayhem in the classroom?
